name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now. living-end has no turn 1-2 spell (its lowest mana value is 3), so what 'unlocks' here is a hand-activated ability instead - an Island or another blue source letting Curator of Mysteries' own Cycling {U} be paid. This never costs life and never asks the fetch machinery to run, so it goes first. Prefers a basic first, never a scarce fetch target - no conditional land in this manabase carries an 'enters tapped unless you control' clause, so the generic template's second prefer tier is dropped rather than kept as a permanent no-op. Stands down whenever a tapped-entering land is also in hand (Commercial District, Hedge Maze, Thundering Falls, Otawara's own conditional twin), the same false key P and F both carry: with a tapped land to sequence in, playing it now while nothing urgent needs the untapped land's mana is strictly better than spending the untapped land's own unlock immediately, and open-land-idle's own prefer order already takes the tapped land first (surveil over tapped over everything else). Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Does not ask about a shockland (open-shock-unlocks) or a fetch (open-fetch-unlocks); those pay something or need a search and rank below this.
